magic-cat-academy.title: Play Magic Cat Academy Online - A Free Halloween Game
magic-cat-academy.slogan: Cast spells and defeat ghosts in Magic Cat Academy!
magic-cat-academy.description: Dive into Magic Cat Academy, a charming game where you, as Momo, defend against spooky ghosts with magical spells. Master drawing symbols to protect the academy and enjoy the delightful Halloween-themed adventure. Play Magic Cat Academy now for a spellbinding experience!

HomeIframe.title: Magic Cat Academy
HomeIframe.description: Join Momo in a magical adventure to save the academy from ghosts!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Magic Cat Academy is a Halloween-themed web game where you play as Momo, a magical cat, defending the academy from ghosts by drawing spells on the screen.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Draw the symbols that appear above the ghosts to cast spells.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Defeat all the ghosts in each level to advance.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Use special symbols like hearts and circles for extra effects!
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Enjoy a visually appealing game with bright colors and cute character designs, perfect for the Halloween season.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Simple controls make it accessible for everyone to pick up and play, using mouse or touch to draw symbols.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: As you progress, the spells become more complex and the ghosts become tougher, providing a fun challenge.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Experience three distinct versions of Magic Cat Academy, each with its own unique storyline and challenges.
